**Summary:**  
This update removes all code and metadata files except documentation, establishing the skill as documentation-only.

- Removed all code, configuration, and metadata files. Only documentation (SKILL.md) remains.
- SKILL.md was updated with a frontmatter section and a brief description.
- The skill now focuses solely on interface knowledge, best practices, and integration guidance for 粤收付, without executable components.
- Clearly states non-supported use cases and cross-references onboarding tasks to a different skill.

cnyepay v1.0.0

- 首次发布技能，包含粤收付（open.cnyepay.com）全流程多语言接口对接能力
- 支持接口知识库咨询、代码生成、问题排查、合规校验等核心能力
- 覆盖 PHP/Java/Python/Go/Node.js 等多语言最佳实践
- 提供详细参数规则、签名验签方案、常见错误码说明及各业务场景指引
- 文档内容聚焦官方接口规范和对接流程

- No code or documentation changes detected in this version.
- Version number updated only; functionality and capabilities remain the same.

cnyepay v0.1.0

- 初始版本发布，提供粤收付（open.cnyepay.com）多语言接口对接全流程支持。
- 覆盖 PHP/Java/Python/Go/Node.js 等主流语言的咨询、代码生成、问题排查和合规校验。
- 内置官方接口知识库，集成常见错误码、支付方式、分账、转账、退款等实用说明及最佳实践。
- 明确交互范式，标准化咨询、代码生成、排查流程和输出规范。
- 限定能力边界，聚焦官方接口范畴，强调安全与合规。
